description: List every ERC721 token_id a wallet owns in a collection via balanceOf + tokenOfOwnerByIndex (ERC721Enumerable). Caps at limit (default 50, max 100). If the collection is not enumerable, returns is_enumerable:false with balance. Example: {contract:"0xBC4C…f13D", address:"0x46ef…2496", chain:"ethereum"}. $0.002 USDC. Related: Owner of one id: /chain/nft-owner $0.001; metadata: /chain/nft-metadata $0.002; owner+metadata: /nft $0.002.
name: chain_erc721_tokens
